meta.title: useDeferredValue — urgent render first, deferred render after

annotations.label: Component declaration
annotations.detail: Typeahead renders the typed text immediately and a deferred copy of it that lags one render behind. React does the urgent update first and the deferred one in a follow-up render.

annotations.label: Deferred copy lags on purpose
annotations.detail: Compare the two numbers on the frame right after typing: text is already updated, deferred still shows the previous value. The next render catches it up.

steps.note: useDeferredValue returns the OLD value during the urgent render and the
Render finished. React commits this tree to the DOM — effects have not run yet.
